scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web -- --host 127.0.0.1"
scripts.format: prettier --write "apps/*/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" apps/*/package.json apps/*/tsconfig*.json apps/web/vite.config.ts package.json playwright.config.ts tests README.md
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w apps/api && node apps/api/dist/seed.js
